sources.title: DeckWeft scope and limitations

limitations: Feature claims remain upstream claims unless independently tested.

sources.title: wesanderson palette definitions

Documentation credits a community palette collection, not an official film colour standard.
limitations: No licensed film-frame timecodes were verified.
The Git blob hash identifies file content; it is not a repository commit hash.

sources.title: Teenage Engineering product catalogue

limitations: A catalogue index is not a full examination of every current, discontinued or collaboration product.

sources.title: Teenage Engineering field system

limitations: The workbench design is an interpretation; no affiliation or claim of copied proprietary geometry.

sources.title: Teenage Engineering OP-1 field
verifiedFindings: Reference for restrained aluminium construction and a compact instrument interface.
limitations: Only surfaced product description reviewed, not a complete physical usability study.

sources.title: Teenage Engineering TP-7
verifiedFindings: Reel interaction provides a functional navigation/scrubbing reference.

A dial is a proposed progressive enhancement, not a required control.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding Contrast (Minimum)
verifiedFindings: Normal text requires 4.5:1; qualifying large text requires 3:1.
Do not round a failing result up to the threshold.
limitations: Checking selected pairs alone is not WCAG conformance.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding Non-text Contrast
verifiedFindings: Meaningful graphical and component boundaries need appropriate contrast, commonly 3:1 against adjacent colours.
limitations: Which marks are essential and which backgrounds are adjacent must be tested in context.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Slider Pattern
verifiedFindings: Keyboard and value semantics inform a dial implemented as a slider.
Touch assistive-technology support needs real testing.
limitations: A numeric slide index is not evidence of complete screen-reader compatibility.

sources.title: OpenAI plugin skills concepts
verifiedFindings: Skills are a documented extension mechanism; inspect host capabilities before choosing an adapter.
limitations: Does not establish a public command called openai slides generate or disclose proprietary Slides internals.

sources.title: OpenAI Codex workflow overview
verifiedFindings: Product material describes workflow capabilities.
limitations: A product description is not an inspected implementation or public API contract.
No Spaces Slides source snapshot was recovered.

sources.title: Garner & Alley (2013): How the Design of Presentation Slides Affects Audience Comprehension of a Technical Presentation
verifiedFindings: A technical-presentation study compared assertion-evidence and conventional slide approaches in an engineering-student sample.
limitations: Context-specific evidence, not proof of universally optimal reading order or persuasion.

sources.title: Meusel, Scheller, Rey & Schneider (2024): background colour cues in learning
verifiedFindings: The reported learning task cautions against assuming that background colour cueing alone guarantees a benefit.
limitations: Task, participant and floor/ceiling limits matter; not a live-presentation optimisation result.

sources.title: Conrad & Obermaier: text-image signalling in geography learning
verifiedFindings: School geography text-image signalling offers a context-specific lead for label/evidence proximity.
limitations: Do not extrapolate a school-learning abstract into a universal adult pitch rule.

sources.title: Sun & Nembhard: The Effect of Highlighting on Cognitive Load and Visual Attention in Multimedia Learning
verifiedFindings: A 2025 research lead involving highlighting and attention measurement was located.
limitations: Full-text access returned HTTP 403; no effect-size, sample-size or outcome claim is made here.

sources.title: OpenAI reasoning effort guidance
verifiedFindings: Effort availability is model-dependent; higher effort can use more tokens and take longer.
xhigh should be evaluated for a justified benefit rather than used indiscriminately.
limitations: No per-task DeckWeft benchmark was performed; all routing decisions are project recommendations.
